path.style: stroke: none; stroke-width: 0; fill: var(--hot); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round
stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round
stroke: var(--teal); stroke-width: 6; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round

stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 2.5; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-dasharray: 6 6
